plate_findings.evidence: Caption: "Multiple enchondromas in the left hand, about 15 enchondroma foci in all phalanges in fingers I-IV and in metacarpal bones I-IV."

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (a, b, c). a: Radiograph of a human left hand showing numerous enchondromas across the phalanges and metacarpals, directly supporting Ollier disease. b: Radiograph of a human left foot showing multiple enchondromas involving the toes and metatarsals, consistent with the multifocal skeletal manifestations of Ollier disease. c: Radiograph of the proximal left tibia demonstrating an enchondroma in a patient with multifocal Ollier disease.
panels.attribution_text: Markevičiūtė et al. Ollier Disease: A Case Series and Literature Review.. Acta medica Lituanica 2021. doi:10.15388/amed.2021.28.1.8. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 4.
panels.figure_caption: a) Multiple enchondromas in the left hand, about 15 enchondroma foci in all phalanges in fingers I-IV and in metacarpal bones I-IV; b) multiple enchondromas in the foot, about 10 enchondroma foci in toes I-V and metatarsals; c) enchondroma in the proximal part of left tibia.
in_text_mentions: ell-being patient did not seek medical attention for years. In 2017, he consulted an orthopedic oncologist complaining of formations and pain in the left hand. Performed studies showed these changes (Fig. 4): multiple enchondromas in the left hand, about 15 enchondroma foci in all phalanges in fingers I-IV and in metacarpal bones I-IV, about 10 enchondroma foci in toes I-V and metatarsals in the left foot, enchondroma in the proximal part of left tibia.
